title: Singing Dog and Wind Chimes
description: A fluffy light-brown dog sits on a sunny wooden porch with its head tilted back and mouth open as if howling or singing. Above, large iridescent wind chimes with a turquoise clapper hang near the house wall while musical notes float through the air.
prompt: A fluffy light brown dog sitting on a wooden porch with head tilted back and mouth open as if singing, large shimmering wind chimes hanging from the roof with turquoise clapper, musical notes floating in the air, round wall clock visible in the background, bright sunny day with strong light and shadows, soft pastel watercolor painting style with sparkles and gentle brushwork
